plants.name: Prunus mume
plants.description: Gnarled branches still bare of leaves burst into fragrant, delicate blossoms. The flowers perfume the cold air of late winter. Ume groves are a beloved sign that spring is on its way.
plants.bloomingSeason: Late winter to early spring (roughly late January to March, peaking in February and early March)
plants.location: Japan, including the Kanto region and Kansai, as well as parts of eastern China
plants.funFact: Ume blossoms were celebrated in Japan before cherry blossoms became the favorite. The same tree produces the fruit used to make umeboshi pickled plums and sweet plum wine.

plants.name: Narcissus pseudonarcissus
plants.description: Nodding golden trumpets ringed by pale, swept-back petals light up woodland floors and meadows. In sheltered spots they appear in drifts of yellow. Their cheerful color is a welcome sight after the grey winter.
plants.bloomingSeason: Late winter to early spring (about late February to April, with early flowers opening in early March in milder areas)
plants.location: Western Europe, including southern England, Wales and France, particularly in woodlands and damp meadows
plants.funFact: Daffodil bulbs contain alkaloids such as galantamine. This compound has been developed into a medication used to treat symptoms of Alzheimer's disease.

plants.name: Eschscholzia californica
plants.description: Silky, cup-shaped flowers glow like tiny lanterns above feathery blue-green foliage. In good wildflower years they cover hillsides in sheets of orange. The petals fold closed on cloudy days and at night.
plants.bloomingSeason: Early spring to early summer in California, with the first flowers often appearing in late winter in warm, southern areas
plants.location: Southern and central California, USA, in grasslands, foothills and desert edges
plants.funFact: California poppy is the state flower of California. Its seed pods burst open when ripe and fling seeds some distance from the parent plant.
